editorial.evidence: Compared all 58 captured sections against the earlier draft paragraph by paragraph. The draft's coverage was templated: it dropped the five-row stakeholder map, the three answer tiers, the seven-step whiteboard architecture, sync/async boundaries, the injection replay that its own figure depicts, the model-to-tool time ratio, the risk register table, the who-decides integration axis and Salesforce mapping, cost scenarios' later/prevent steps and cache-key rule, the near-miss scorecard and spoken answer, and every memorable interview quote; it also gave three different plane figures one caption and said a 'refund ledger' owned refund history. These are restored in the walkthrough and deep dives; six follow-ups became answer-11 to answer-16. Our own qualifications (combined 43.2 GB/day audit total, model API sized by concurrency not cores, 'no unauthorised money' is not 'no money', kill-switch limits, distinct identities for identical refunds) are marked as ours. The brief now defines bounded action, deterministic service and idempotent gateway before use and maps the related variant cases.
